case_classification.short_description: DCF (two methods) with given estimates, 3-SM based on extensive forecasting/modeling

ai_time_estimate_reasoning: This is a highly complex and comprehensive three-statement and DCF valuation modeling task. It requires building multiple intricate sub-schedules, including a step-function machine capacity and employee staffing schedule, a custom vintage/batch schedule for Other PP&E, an annuity loan amortization with current/long-term splits, and precise working capital logic (with specific rules for energy, tax, and distribution payables). Furthermore, the DCF section involves complex elements like a time-weighted average terminal value, 30/360 balance sheet interpolation for the mid-year equity bridge, and an iterative WACC loop alongside a target capital structure WACC. Ensuring the balance sheet balances and resolving the circular WACC reference will take an expert modeler considerable time to implement and audit.
